jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d) - EMEA based (IT-Service-Delivery-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d)  is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Leadership & Operations

- Lead and develop a regional team of SD Managers responsible for engineering support across EMEA sites.- Own regional SLO/SLA performance; ensure targets are met, tracked, and reported consistently.- Drive operational consistency across EMEA sites aligned to global GES standards and Global Operations Excellence (GOE) defined processes.- Act as the primary escalation point for EMEA service issues, customer concerns, and critical incidents.- Ensure CMDB accuracy, asset management, and monitoring compliance across EMEA sites.

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Substantial relevant experience in service delivery, infrastructure operations, or engineering support, with a demonstrated track record of regional management responsibility across multiple countries.- Proven experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple countries within the EMEA region.- Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and service level management practices.- Experience managing escalations, service performance, and operational governance in a complex enterprise environment.- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional programmes and change within large, matrixed organizations.- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English (additional language proficiency is an advantage).- Solid understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle tracking, and software asset inventory across distributed sites.- Practical knowledge of data center operations, including RDC/colocation environments, physical infrastructure management, and capacity oversight.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup frameworks sufficient to manage and govern SD teams responsible for these environments.- Awareness of vulnerability management practices, including coordination with security teams on remediation tracking and compliance obligations across EMEA sites.- Familiarity with software development practices and the SDLC; ability to engage with engineering teams on environment needs and tooling requirements without deep hands-on development experience.- Awareness of CI/CD concepts and pipeline dependencies; sufficient understanding to identify where GES infrastructure is a bottleneck or enabler for engineering delivery.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering or large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.- Hands-on or supervisory experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack or equivalent platforms).- Exposure to high-performance or grid computing environments — understanding of compute cluster operations, job scheduling, and distributed infrastructure management.- Understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery across EMEA.- Experience managing EMEA-specific regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., data residency, works council processes, GDPR implications for IT operations).- Exposure to software engineering or DevOps environments — direct collaboration with development teams or platform engineering; comfort discussing developer workflow tooling, build pipelines, and environment provisioning.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required at minimum; Managing Professional track highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation — IT governance and control framework awareness.- ISO 27001 awareness — relevant to EMEA regulatory and security compliance considerations.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This role is based in EMEA, with a preference for one of Siemens' DISW established locations.
Regular travel across EMEA sites is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Director, GES Global Service Delivery
Part of: GES Global Service Delivery function, GTI

We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

(Senior) Research Associate - Protein Science (gn)
Antibody Discovery & Development · Martinsried / Munich · Full-time

About us
iOmx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in the field of immuno-oncology, located in Martinsried/Munich, Germany. We are focused on the development of novel biomarker-supported cancer immunotherapies and are propagating an evolving pipeline of powerful multifunctional antibodies and T cell engagers. We are looking for highly motivated, self-driven and competent colleagues who share our vision and want to help turn it into reality. As part of our Protein Science team within the Antibody Discovery and Development Department, you will focus on the expression of recombinant proteins, antibodies and multispecific molecules in mammalian expression systems. You will advance the development of our transient expression platform, driving the discovery and development of innovative large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Your responsibilities will include:

Plan and execute transient transfections in HEK and CHO - at various research scales
Develop and optimize our transient expression platforms: process, scale-up, yield, and quality
Run the molecular biology behind it: cloning and plasmid DNA prep at transfection scale
Contribute to construct design and feasibility assessment
Step in as dedicated backup for protein purification and downstream processing
Support analytics: characterization of recombinant proteins using state-of-the-art biochemical and biophysical methods (SDS-PAGE, LAL assay, HPLC)
Take responsibility for protein science lab equipment and infrastructure
Carefully evaluate, interpret, and document results in electronic lab journals and databases
Present data in internal meetings
You are the ideal candidate for this position if you bring the following:

You hold a vocational qualification as CTA, BTA, MTA or an equivalent university degree in a relevant field; at least 4 years of professional laboratory experience is preferred
You have in-depth experience in mammalian cell culture and transient transfection (HEK, CHO)
You have solid experience in cloning and molecular biology techniques; experience in construct design is a plus
You consider downstream processing and adjacent analytical methods as a welcome variety of your daily business
You pay attention to detail in experimental execution and documentation and have solid knowledge of relevant lab techniques and equipment, as well as standard laboratory and MS Office software
You are a well-organized, reliable team player with a hands-on mentality and strong communication skills
You work independently and efficiently, and adapt quickly to changing demands in a collaborative environment
You are proficient in English, both spoken and written
We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company with around 45 employees, driven by a shared purpose: to transform cancer treatment for patients. We work with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes, in a welcoming and trusting environment where real progress comes from working together. What you can expect from us:

Work that matters: your work feeds directly into our pipeline of cancer immunotherapies, from multifunctional antibodies to T cell engagers on their way to the clinic
Real impact in a small team: your work is visible and you take on responsibility early
A culture of curiosity, integrity, and collaboration: we value diverse perspectives, open communication, and a hands-on mindset, in an environment where people grow together
On top of that: 30 days of vacation, flexible working hours, and support for a job bike or Deutschlandticket

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships across assigned industrial markets and territory. Reporting to the Global Commercial Leader, you will execute strategic sales initiatives, identify opportunities for market expansion, and deliver value-driven solutions that help customers improve their manufacturing processes.

Your technical expertise, consultative selling approach, and ability to build lasting customer partnerships will be essential in achieving sales objectives and supporting the continued growth and profitability of the business.

- Provide valuable market intelligence by monitoring market trends, competitive activities and customer-specific requirements.

- Engage customers with AI-enabled discussions and commercial solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer experience through responsiveness, technical expertise and solution-oriented support.
- Demonstrate and present the technical capabilities and business value of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Quality Control Systems.
- Collaborate closely with application specialists, service engineers, software experts and product management to develop customer-specific solutions.
- Maintain a high level of product, application, industry and AI knowledge to effectively position our solutions.
- Travel throughout the assigned territory and internationally as required, with approximately 50% overnight travel.

- Drive sales growth by achieving commercial targets across the assigned territory.
- Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
- Lead complex technical sales engagements from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
- Deliver consultative, value-based sales solutions tailored to customer manufacturing processes.
- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.
- Utilize Salesforce.com to manage opportunities, forecasting and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends and competitive activities to support strategic business growth.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific through regular customer visits and extensive travel.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience.

Experience

- Minimum of 3 years of successful technical sales experience in capital equipment, industrial instrumentation, process analytics or industrial automation.
- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal
- Packaging & Converting
- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) together with digital sales and collaboration tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
- Additional language skills are an advantage.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively.

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

The life sciences increasingly depend on advanced services offered by core facilities, synchrotrons, data services and other research infrastructures, creating a need for highly-skilled professionals who can operate, improve and expand these scientific services.

EMBL’s ARISE2 programme offers over 20 fully funded, three-year postdoctoral fellowships for researchers with STEM backgrounds who are interested in advancing their careers in research infrastructures in academia or industry. ARISE2 fellows will:

Develop a method or development within EMBL’s areas of expertise, with potential for broader service application
Receive structured training in the operation and management of research infrastructures, including service provision, project and staff management, innovation, science policy, FAIR principals and AI.
Build professional networks through secondment and job shadowing at EMBL and ARISE2 partner organisations

ARISE2 projects should align with EMBL’s research areas-such as genomics, structural biology, imaging, cell and tissue biology, environmental research, and translational applications-while contributing to the development of services that support the wider life science community.

You may develop projects in fields including:

Data and computational science: Bioinformatics, AI/ML, computational modelling, software engineering, data management, data science.

Imaging and optical engineering: Imaging and image analysis, optical engineering, detector development, microscopy, X-ray optics

Structural Biology and Mechanical Engineering: Automation, high-precision mechanics, microfluidics, robotics, X-ray crystallography

Biotechnology: (Bio)chemical engineering, chemistry or chemical biology, omics technologies.

A Ph.D. at the time of the call deadline (September 30, 2026). Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis but who have not yet been formally awarded the degree are eligible to apply.
A university degree in a relevant STEM discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics)
Experience in technology development - experience can be from academia and/or industry and should be relevant to the research fields of our groups and teams that are participating in the programme.
Strong research potential that can be illustrated by a diverse set of research outputs (e.g., publications, software, data sets, patents, technical documentation, contribution to technology development or other innovative research etc.)
The ability to work independently and in a collaborative settings
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
Good organisational and time-management skills

You might also have

Experience in the improvement or development of methods, techniques or technology for service provision.

ARISE2 receives funding from HorizonEurope under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie action COFUND (grant agreement No 101178241).  EMBL is Europe’s flagship research laboratory for the life sciences - an intergovernmental organisation performing scientific research in disciplines including molecular biology, physics, chemistry and computer science. We are an international laboratory with more than 2000 employees from many nations, operating across six sites, in Heidelberg (HQ), Barcelona, Hinxton near Cambridge, Hamburg, Grenoble and Rome. One of our missions is to provide access to advanced technologies and engage in technology transfer activities.

EMBL is a curiosity-driven, community-oriented and international organisation. As an inclusive, equal opportunity employer, we believe that diversity enables us to collaborate more effectively and be innovative in our approaches. We are, therefore, committed to creating an inclusive and flexible culture - one where everyone can realise their full potential and make a positive contribution to our organisation. We operate by our values of: openness, inclusion, integrity, transparency, fairness.

jobs.description:
For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:

PhD student for TIQTOC optical atomic clock experiment for Ultra-light Dark Matter

Remuneration Group E13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: APDO006/2026 | Deadline: open | Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Zeuthen location of DESY has a strong focus on astroparticle and particle physics (gamma-ray and neutrino astronomy, and collider particle physics). The experimental groups are accompanied by a strong theory group. DESY Zeuthen is responsible for developing and delivering detectors for astroparticle and particle physics experiments, and is actively engaged in R&D for future applications.

With the Centre for Quantum Technology and Applications (CQTA), DESY Zeuthen is taking a leading role in applying quantum technology to challenges in particle and astroparticle physics. A new search for the effects of ultralight dark matter is being constructed, using ultra-sensitive optical atomic clocks as the sensing element. The post holder will contribute to this search, developing a test setup for networked clock comparison and frequency stabilisation. The post holder will also help to develop the procedures to collect and analyse the frequency comparisons, forming the basis of fundamental physics searches for (e.g.) ultralight dark matter.

About your role:

- Active role in developing test infrastructure for optical atomic clocks and comparison to reference clocks
- Develop instrumentation for measuring fundamental constants
- Participate in building up clock-based experiments at Humboldt University, DESY, Heidelberg or U. Birmingham
- Analyse experimental atomic clock data and participate in the interpretation of results

About you:

- Experience in one of the relevant physics fields (e.g. particle, atomic/nuclear physics, quantum optics) with Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience with detector physics, with good computer programming skills
- Very good command of English is required and knowledge of German is of advantage
- Willingness to travel and participate in working meetings, conferences, and field work abroad (e.g. at MPIK Heidelberg)
- Strong motivation, very good organizational skills, resilience; ability to work in teams and excellent communication skills

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours and variable part-time. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the

TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Prof. Steven Worm at +49 33762-7-7208 [(steven.worm@desy.de).](https://mailto:(steven.worm@desy.de)

DESY in Zeuthen does not grant doctoral degrees directly but collaborates with the University of Potsdam or the Humboldt University. Candidates for thesis research will have to satisfy the terms of admission for doctoral theses of the University. PhD students receive a monthly salary of 67% of the payment of the remuneration group 13 TVöD (Federal Government).

Snapshot of your Day

As a Data Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within Siemens Energy. Working closely with more than 30 factories across our global Manufacturing Network, you will contribute to the development and adoption of our secure, centrally governed, and AI-enabled Data Mesh.

Your focus will be on transforming scalable data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and sustainable business growth. By analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into analytical solutions, you will drive cross-functional data and analytics initiatives that enhance competitiveness and support the future development of our products and processes. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Conducting in-depth analyses of manufacturing and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement across the business area
* Supporting the definition, development, and continuous refinement of data structures and data products, with a focus on data quality, consistency, and usability
* Collaboration with data engineering and cloud architecture teams to ensure analytical requirements are reflected in data ingestion processes, data models, and platform capabilities
* Development and maintenance of dashboards, KPIs, reports, and lightweight analytical applications to increase transparency and support data-driven decision-making
* Continuous evaluation and optimization of analytical workflows, performance metrics, and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency and business value creation
* Provision of actionable insights and analytical recommendations to support strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization

What You Bring
* Academic degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, combined with professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven process optimization
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including hands-on experience with modern data and analytics tools such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Alteryx, Python, and SQL
* Expertise in the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting solutions, and data visualizations using leading business intelligence platforms such as Power BI and Tableau
* Solid understanding of cloud-based data ecosystems, preferably Snowflake and AWS, as well as modern data stack concepts including ELT processes and data modeling
* Ability to transform complex datasets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and decision-relevant information for stakeholders across all organizational levels
* Business fluency in English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, an international mindset and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Department Pediatric Neurooncology is looking, starting from 01.11.2026, for a Strategic Officer.

The department led by Prof. Stefan Pfister at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) and the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center Heidelberg (KiTZ) combines international pediatric oncology research with data-driven precision oncology and the development of sustainable research infrastructures.

A key international initiative of the department is the ITCC PedCanPortal, a data and research platform developed in collaboration with leading European partners in pediatric oncology. The project aims to bring together a large, international multi-omics dataset comprising molecular and clinical data from more than 5,000 patients and to make these high-quality research data, along with analytical tools, accessible and sustainably available to the international research community. In doing so, the ITCC PedCanPortal aims to support the development of new diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for children and adolescents with cancer.

The Strategic Officer will work at the interface of science, strategy, international partnerships, and the sustainable development of the ITCC PedCanPortal, with a particular focus on establishing the organizational and financial structures required for its long-term sustainability.

Your Tasks

As Strategy Officer, you will be embedded within the central coordination structure of ITCC PedCanPortal and work closely with the project leadership, international consortium partners, patient representatives, advisory bodies, and external stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to develop, coordinate, and implement a comprehensive long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal beyond its current funding period (e.g., via a non-profit spin-off). Sustainability planning will be treated as a continuous and evolving process, closely aligned with the scientific, technical, ethical, and operational development of the platform.

Key responsibilities:

Strategic development and sustainability planning

- Develop and continuously refine a long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal
- Design governance and operational models for the future operation and expansion of the platform
- Evaluate and develop sustainable funding and partnership models
- Support the onboarding of future programs, projects, and stakeholders into the ITCC PedCanPortal ecosystem

Stakeholder management and international coordination

- Coordinate continuity-related activities across a large international consortium
- Facilitate interactions with academic partners, patient representatives, external stakeholders, and industry collaborators
- Support strategic discussions within governance and advisory structures
- Build and maintain strong relationships across the international pediatric oncology community

Governance, reporting, and implementation

- Ensure alignment of continuity planning with scientific, ethical, legal, and operational requirements
- Prepare strategic reports, recommendations, and implementation concepts for project leadership and governance bodies
- Contribute to annual reporting, risk assessment, and long-term planning activities
- Support the translation of strategic concepts into operational implementation plans

Your Profile

We are looking for a highly organized and strategically minded individual who enjoys working at the intersection of science, innovation and international collaboration.

Essential:

- PhD or 5+ years experience in life sciences, medicine, public health, health economics, management, law or a related discipline.
- Experience in scientific program management, research strategy, innovation management, business development or international collaborative projects.
- Excellent organizational and communication skills.
- Experience working with diverse stakeholder groups in complex international environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable:

- Experience with large-scale research infrastructures, data platforms or precision medicine initiatives.
- Understanding of governance, continuity planning and funding strategies.
- Experience in public-private partnerships, translational research or health innovation.
